class: State learned by one run overwritten by the next run's start-up
symptom: Waystar, 2 October: resuming from the Workday sign-in page, the check said 'waystar.wd1.myworkdayjobs.com is not where this application was (careers.waystar.com)' and started again from the posting.
site: Any application whose posting and form are on different hosts (employer careers site + Workday)
root_cause: checkpoint.note_application rewrote data['application'] at every run's start, dropping the 'hosts' list that checkpoint.verified had built from the pages the application was worked on.
why_tests_missed: The resume tests noted the application and verified pages within one run; none started a second run before reconciling.
fix: note_application keeps the hosts already verified for the application.
prevention: A start-up write merges into stored state; it never replaces what earlier runs learned.
